title: Terms & Conditions
intro: Welcome to OpenPal. OpenPal is a community app that helps students find and share rides with other students. By creating an account and using OpenPal, you agree to the terms below. Please read them carefully — they explain what we do with your information and what you are responsible for.

sections.title: 1. What OpenPal is for
sections.body: OpenPal exists to help students connect with one another to arrange rides. The information you share — your name, school, graduation date, phone number, posts, and messages — is used to match you with and introduce you to other students so you can coordinate trips together. That is the purpose of the app, and it is why we ask for these details.

sections.title: 2. We do not sell your information
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information to anyone. We do not trade it, rent it, or hand it to advertisers or data brokers. The details you share are used only to operate OpenPal and to help other students find you for the purpose of arranging rides.

sections.title: 3. We do not make money from OpenPal
sections.body: As of now, OpenPal does not make money from this service. We do not charge you to use the app and we do not earn revenue from your data. If this ever changes, we will update these terms and let you know before any new terms take effect.

sections.title: 4. You are responsible for who you interact with
sections.body: OpenPal helps you discover other students, but we do not vet, verify, or vouch for the people you meet through the app. You are responsible for knowing who you are interacting with. Use your own judgment, take normal safety precautions, and decide for yourself whether to ride with, meet, or trust another person. We are not responsible for the conduct of any user, and we cannot guarantee that anyone is who they say they are.

sections.title: 5. Sharing your contact details is your choice
sections.body: Choosing to share your phone number or any other contact information with other students is entirely your decision. If you share your phone number, you do so at your own discretion and at your own risk. We do not take responsibility for what happens after you share it, including how another person uses or passes along your contact information.

sections.title: 6. Your responsibilities
sections.body: You agree to provide accurate information about yourself, to use OpenPal only for arranging rides with other students, and to treat other users with respect. You are responsible for your own arrangements, including agreeing on pickup times, costs, and any other details directly with the other person.

sections.title: 7. Community conduct, reporting, and blocking
sections.body: There is zero tolerance for objectionable content or abusive behavior on OpenPal. You agree not to post content that is harassing, threatening, hateful, sexually explicit, illegal, or otherwise objectionable, and not to abuse other users. If you encounter content or a user that violates these terms, use the “Report” option to flag it, or “Block” to instantly stop seeing that user and prevent them from contacting you. Reports and blocks are sent to us for review, and we may remove content or remove users who violate these terms, typically within 24 hours.

sections.title: 8. No warranty
sections.body: OpenPal is provided “as is.” We do our best to keep the app running and useful, but we do not promise that it will always be available, error-free, or that any ride you arrange will take place. To the extent allowed by law, we are not liable for any loss, harm, or damage that results from using the app or from interactions with other users.

sections.title: 9. Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. When we make a meaningful change, we will update the “last updated” date above and, where appropriate, notify you in the app. Continuing to use OpenPal after a change means you accept the updated terms.

sections.title: 10. Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about these terms or your information, you can reach us through the “Report an issue” option in your profile.

footer: By creating an account, you confirm that you have read and agree to these Terms & Conditions.
